correctness.rationale: The exact source theorem quantifies over every positive a,b,c and every prime-power q and counts individual full three-block radical matrices. Direct multiplication gives X^2=0 iff AB=0. Rank i of A has R_q(a,b,i) choices; rank j of B factoring through ker A has R_q(b-i,c,j) choices. The map C -> pi C|ker(B), targeting Hom(ker B,F_q^a/im A), is surjective with constant fiber q^[ac-(a-i)(c-j)], and rank X=i+j+rank(pi C|ker B), giving the displayed three-sum polynomial and all empty-target boundaries. The independent one-sum count q^ac sum_i R_q(a,b,i)q^[c(b-i)] follows by freely choosing B and C. The bound min(floor((a+b+c)/2),a+b,a+c,b+c) follows from X^2=0 and block supports; a matching on complete tripartite coordinate parts realizes every rank up to the bound, with X^2=0. Independently written exhaustive q=2/3 block enumeration corroborates the formula, including P_222^(2)=1+81T+630T^2+216T^3; tests do not prove all q.
